name: Pauline Lynch
bio: Pauline Lynch is known for Trainspotting (1996), T2 Trainspotting (2017) and Attila (2001).

credits.overview: Lucy, a failed actor who lives in a dysfunctional relationship with agoraphobic screenwriter Paul, is surprised to find herself on the cusp of a none-too-secret affair with her new work colleague, Daniel. credits.title: T2 Trainspotting
credits.overview: After 20 years abroad, Mark Renton returns to Scotland and reunites with his old friends Sick Boy, Spud and Begbie.

credits.title: The Flying Scotsman
credits.overview: Based on the incredible true story of amateur cyclist Graeme Obree, who breaks the world one-hour record on a bike he made out of washing machine parts.

credits.title: Attila
credits.overview: A vengeful beauty foils the plans of the bloodthirsty Hun warrior to conquer Rome.

credits.title: Beautiful Creatures
credits.overview: When Petula and Dorothy cover up the accidental murder of one jerk boyfriend, they hatch a hilarious scheme to collect a huge ransom.

credits.overview: Heroin addict Mark Renton stumbles through bad ideas and sobriety attempts with his unreliable friends --Sick Boy, Begbie, Spud and Tommy.
